notes.title: April '86
notes.content: You can now play the demo of "April 86". The demo will be available to download from October 9th, 2023, to October 16th, 2023.

notes.title: April ‘86
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44142574/fd673e734f7a065ad27f82aa3b28ffa790e73e2c.png[/img]
On the 9th of October, the demo version of April ‘86 will become available for download. This demo will be available only during the Steam Festival because the game is still in development and will be worked on and improved in the future. We will also be dedicating a lot of our time and resources to the optimization of the game. At the present time, the game is 60% complete. The demo version is only a small part of the overall game, and its purpose is to give you a chance to become more familiar with the final product.

Don’t forget to add April ‘86 to your wishlist. The release date is 2024.
Thank you.
